狡诈如狼：每场战斗限一次，在您拼骰决定先手权

cards.text:
狼侦察
杀戮小队
原型：侦察，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名狼侦察芬里斯狼
↘ 5 名狼侦察特工，从以下列表中进行选择：
• 狼群领袖
• 獠牙使者
• 霜眼
• 炮手
• 陷阱大师
• 符文祭司诗人
• 猎手
除了猎手特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳
入您的杀戮小队一次。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUTS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: RECON, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 WOLF SCOUT FENRISIAN WOLF
↘ 5 WOLF SCOUT operatives selected from the
following list:
• PACK LEADER
• FANGBEARER
• FROSTEYE
• GUNNER
• TRAPMASTER
• RUNE PRIEST SKJALD
• HUNTER
Other than HUNTER operatives, your kill team can
only include each operative on this list once.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营规则
元素风暴
据一些太空野狼的战斗修士所述，狼侦察们与
风暴同行。在很多时候，随行的符文祭司诗人
会召唤异常的狂风暴雨。在其他时候，狼侦察
能够巧妙地运用当地的气候现象或者利用神秘
科技来改变天气。他们能够在这种风暴的隐藏
之下进行长时间的秘密行动；以此掩盖行踪并
扰乱猎物的感官，狼侦察的敌人感到自己是在
与自然本身战斗。
战略计划。将己方风暴标识移出杀戮区
（若有)，随后将其放置在杀戮区中。每当一名
特工完全位于那个标识的水平 6" 内时，那名特
工完全位于己方风暴内。
如果己方狼侦察特工在执行冲锋行动的结束时
完全位于己方风暴内，那么那名特工可以在拥有
隐匿命令的情况下执行冲锋行动。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION RULE
ELEMENTAL STORM
It is said by some battle-brothers that their Chapter’s
Wolf Scouts take the storm with them. In many cases,
these tempestuous upheavals truly are supernatural,
called into being by accompanying Rune Priest Skjalds.
At other times, Wolf Scouts skilfully time their hunts to
coincide with local atmospheric phenomena or instigate
them with arcane technologies. Wolf Scouts can operate
for extended periods hidden by such storms; using the
cover to mask their movements and confuse the senses
of their prey, their enemies feel they are fighting the
very elements themselves.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Remove your Storm marker
from the killzone (if any), then place it in the
killzone. Whenever an operative is wholly within
6" horizontally of your Storm marker, it’s wholly
within your STORM.
Each friendly WOLF SCOUT operative can
perform the Charge action while it has a
Conceal order if it ends that action wholly within
your STORM.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营规则
猎手阿斯塔特
狼侦察是身经百战的星际战士，在狩猎时极为
致命。这些受到基因改造的超人战士毫无怜悯
之心，能够利用怪异的天气现象来隐藏自己
的行踪。
在每个己方狼侦察特工的激活期间，特工可以
执行两次射击行动或者两次近战行动。如果进行
两次射击行动：
• 如果两次射击行动都使用等离子枪或者等离子
手枪，那么第二次行动必须消耗额外 1AP。
• 您不能选择使用两件灵能远程武器。
每一名己方狼侦察特工可以进行反应，无论其
拥有的命令。在位于己方风暴中的特工进行反应
时，您可以先更改特工的命令，或者选择只更改
特工的命令（在这种情况下，依旧将特工视作为
在转折点中进行了反应)。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION RULE
HUNTING ASTARTES
Wolf Scouts are experienced Space Marines who
are utterly lethal on the hunt. These genetically
modified superhumans are merciless warriors capable
of exploiting strange climatic events to conceal
their approach.
During each friendly WOLF SCOUT operative’s
activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions
or two Fight actions. If it’s two Shoot actions:
• 1 additional AP must be spent for the second
action if both actions are using a plasma gun or
plasma pistol.
• You cannot select two PSYCHIC
ranged weapons.
Each friendly WOLF SCOUT operative can
counteract regardless of its order. Whenever
it does so within your STORM, you can change
its order first, or change its order instead of
performing an action (for the latter, still treat it as
having counteracted this turning point).

cards.text:
狼侦察
战略计谋
隐藏于暴风
狼侦察能够熟练地运用非自然的暴风来获取优
势，绝望的猎物很少有机会能够精准射击。
每当一名特工对一名完全位于己方风暴内的己
方狼侦察特工进行射击时，您可以重掷一枚防
御骰。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
STRATEGY PLOY
CLOAKED BY THE STORM
Wolf Scouts are expert in using the uncanny tempests
around them to their advantage, ensuring their
desperate prey rarely get a clean shot.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
WOLF SCOUT operative that’s wholly within your
STORM, you can re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
狼侦察
战略计谋
寒风之怒
在被激怒后，狼侦察的原始怒火就和芬里斯的
寒冬暴雪以及火之季节的霹雳闪电一样猛烈。
每当一名己方狼侦察特工进行近战或反击时，
如果那名特工完全位于己方风暴内，或者在激活
开始时完全位于己方风暴内，那么其近战武器拥
有“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
STRATEGY PLOY
TEMPESTUOUS WRATH
When roused, the elemental fury of Wolf Scouts is
as ferocious as that of Fenris’ winter storms or the
crackling lightning of its Season of Fire.
Whenever a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative
is fighting or retaliating, if it’s wholly within your
STORM or was wholly within your STORM at the
start of the activation, its melee weapons have
the Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
狼侦察
战略计谋
狂风肆虐
暴露在严酷的气候、飞舞的碎片和亚空间能量
的鞭打之下时，狼侦察的敌人难以进行专注。
每当一名己方狼侦察特工对完全位于己方风暴
内的一名敌方特工近战时，将那名敌方特工近战
武器的攻击属性减少 1 点（最低降至 3)。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
STRATEGY PLOY
STORM’S BITE
Subjected to numbing temperatures, flying debris or the
empyric lash of a Rune Priest Skjald, the Wolf Scouts’
enemies struggle to focus their wrath and skill.
Whenever a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative is
fighting against an enemy operative that’s wholly
within your STORM, subtract 1 from the Atk stat
of that enemy operative’s melee weapons (to a
minimum of 3).

cards.text:
狼侦察
战略计谋
狂野斗士
在将猎物逼至死角后，狼侦察们会野蛮地继续
施压，确保每一刻都在弱化目标的反抗能力。
每当一名己方狼侦察特工完成反击时，如果那
名特工没有被残废并且依然在位于那次流程中对
应敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以在流程中
对那名敌方特工造成 D3+1 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
STRATEGY PLOY
SAVAGE FIGHTERS
Once their prey have been cornered, the Wolf Scouts
savagely sustain the pressure, ensuring no opportunity
is missed to weaken their quarry.
Whenever a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative
finishes retaliating, if it wasn’t incapacitated and
is still within control range of the enemy operative
in that sequence, you can inflict D3+1 damage on
that enemy operative.

cards.text:
狼侦察
交战计谋
敏锐感官
鲁斯之子的敏锐感官和狼侦察的狩猎直觉让这
些特工能够准确地追踪猎物，无论他们藏在什
么样的位置。
在一名己方狼侦察特工执行射击行动并选择有
效目标时使用本交战计谋。直到那次行动结束
前，那名己方特工的远程武器拥有“范围 6"”
和“追踪轻型”武器规则，并且敌方特工不能被
遮挡。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ACUTE SENSES
The heightened acuity of the sons of Russ coupled with
the keen hunter’s instincts of an experienced Wolf Scout
enable these operatives to pick out their prey no matter
where they hide.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly WOLF
SCOUT operative performs the Shoot action
and you’re selecting a valid target. Until the end
of that action, that friendly operative’s ranged
weapons have the Range 6" and Seek Light
weapon rules and enemy operatives cannot
be obscured.

cards.text:
狼侦察
交战计谋
反击
最为卓越的猎人绝不会错过任何一个发起突袭
的时机，他们在猎物最脆弱的时刻发起进攻。
在一名敌方特工的激活结束后，或者在一名敌方
特工执行了近战行动后使用本交战计谋。一名己
方狼侦察特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的近战
行动，但是您不能选择那名敌方特工以外的其他
特工作为近战目标。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COUNTERATTACK
The greatest hunters know never to waste the chance
to make an unexpected lunge, their prey at its most
vulnerable just as they strike.
Use this firefight ploy at the end of an enemy
operative’s activation, or after an enemy
operative performs the Fight action. One friendly
WOLF SCOUT operative can immediately
perform a free Fight action, but you cannot select
any other enemy operative to fight against during
that action.

cards.text:
狼侦察
交战计谋
洛基雅尔之魂
狼侦察拥有极为强烈的独立精神。那些错认为
他们被孤立的敌人很快就会后悔追击这些凶险
的生存者。
在一名己方狼侦察特工（芬里斯狼除外）掷攻
击骰后使用本交战计谋。如果那名特工位于其他
己方特工的 5" 外，那么您可以重掷任何自己的
攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TOUCHED BY LOKYAR
Independence of spirit is exceptionally strong amongst
Wolf Scouts. Enemies who believe them vulnerably
isolated soon regret tackling these vicious survivalists.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative (excluding
FENRISIAN WOLF), if it’s fighting more than 5"
from other friendly operatives. You can re-roll any
of your attack dice.

cards.text:
狼侦察
交战计谋
超人体格
受到基因改造的太空野狼能够承受那些对凡人
来说致命的重伤。
在一名敌方特工对己方狼侦察特工（芬里斯狼
除外）进行射击时使用此交战计谋。在掷防御骰
步骤中，您可以将一枚普通成功作为关键成功进
行保留。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
The genetically modified physiology of the Space
Wolves is capable of resisting wounds that would kill a
lesser being.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative
(excluding FENRISIAN WOLF), in the Roll Defence
Dice step. You can retain one of your normal
successes as a critical success instead.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营装备
冰霜武器
这种寒冷的武器由一位钢铁祭司锻造而成，刀
刃极为锋利。一些武器中会含有冰霜海怪的尖
牙或者能量钻石的碎片，看上去就像是用冰块
制成的。
每当一名己方狼侦察特工位于己方风暴内，
则它的格斗刀（若有）拥有“致命 5+ ”武器规
则。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
FROST WEAPONS
These blisteringly cold weapons are crafted by a master
Iron Priest and boast lethal edges. Some incorporate
ice kraken fangs while others are shards of energised
diamond, appearing as if forged from purest ice.
Whenever a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative is
wholly within your STORM, its combat blade (if
any) has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营装备
符文守护
一名战士的武器装备上会刻有精美的符文，但
是只有符文祭司知道如何雕刻这些更为强大的
守护，太空野狼的战士们相信它们能够守护自
己的灵魂。
每个转折点限一次，在一名特工对完全位于己
方风暴内的一名己方狼侦察特工（芬里斯狼除
外）进行射击时，在掷防御骰步骤开始的时候，
您可以使用本规则。若使用，那么直到那次流程
结束前，“穿刺”武器规则的 x 数值减少 1 点（
若有)。这意味着“穿刺 1" 武器规则将被忽视。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RUNIC CHARMS
Many pieces of a warrior’s wargear are artfully inscribed
with runes, but only the enigmatic Rune Priests know
the secrets of etching these more potent charms, which
the Space Wolves believe can ward their very souls.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative
(excluding FENRISIAN WOLF) that’s wholly within
your STORM, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice
step, you can use this rule. If you do, worsen the x
of the Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any) until the
end of that sequence. Note that Piercing 1 would
therefore be ignored.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营装备
狼牙项链
太空野狼会在战团的堡垒修道院：狼牙堡中竞
争佩戴这种饰品的权利。它们是对战士们的武
艺，以及克服难关的强大力量和毅力的认可。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方狼侦察特工
（芬里斯狼除外）进行射击、近战或反击时，如
果您掷出两次或更多失败，那么您可以舍弃其中
一枚骰子，并将另一枚作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WOLFTEETH NECKLACES
The right to wear one of these fetishes may be
earned in the contests of might held in the Chapter’s
fortress monastery: the Fang. They recognise the
bearer’s martial skill, and their capacity to draw upon
great reserves of genetically augmented strength
and perseverance.
Once per turning point, when a friendly WOLF
SCOUT operative (excluding FENRISIAN WOLF)
is shooting, fighting or retaliating, if you roll two or
more fails, you can discard one of them to retain
another as a normal success instead.

cards.text:
狼侦察
阵营装备
战利品护符
鲁斯之子们用厚重的毛皮、动物颅骨和尾毛来
装饰自己的护甲。这些战利品都来自于战士们
在芬里斯亲自猎杀的野兽，它们被认为是带来
好运的饰品，也能够抵御邪恶力量的攻击。
每当一名完全位于己方风暴内的己方狼侦察特
工（芬里斯狼除外）进行近战或反击时，在结算
攻击骰步骤中，您可以让一次普通成功造成的伤
害减少 1 点。
cards.text_en:
WOLF SCOUT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TALISMANIC TROPHIES
Thick pelts, skulls and tails adorn these sons of Russ.
These trophies – taken from huge lupine beasts they
have tracked and killed on Fenris – are seen as potent
tokens of luck and protection against malign attacks.
Whenever a friendly WOLF SCOUT operative
(excluding FENRISIAN WOLF) that’s wholly
within your STORM is fighting or retaliating, in
the Resolve Attack Dice step, you can subtract
1 from the damage inflicted on it from one
normal success.
